name: @arclightning/web
description: Arc Lightning web app, served by `arcl serve` or published as a claude.ai artifact

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @arclightning/ui exec svelte-kit sync && vite build
scripts.build:artifact: pnpm --filter @arclightning/ui exec svelte-kit sync && svelte-kit sync && VITE_ARCL_TARGET=artifact vite build
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/e2e-build.mjs web artifact arcl && playwright test --project e2e
scripts.test:visual: node scripts/e2e-build.mjs web && playwright test --project visual
scripts.test:visual:update: node scripts/e2e-build.mjs web && playwright test --project visual --update-snapshots
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/e2e-build.mjs web && playwright test --project screenshots
